title: Atlas Journal Frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of a Journal (journal/*.md) — the Markdown file of ONE ISO week, id = filename = the week id YYYY-Www (issue #180). The frontmatter carries only the week and its Wochenziele; the work itself lives in the body: a day is a heading of the topmost level '## <Wochentag> YYYY-MM-DD' (the DATE is authoritative, the weekday is decoration written by Atlas), and under it GFM checklists — the Tasks. Day sections come into being with their first Task and are kept in ascending date order; a date outside the week is a validation error. Task line grammar (body, never frontmatter): '- [ ] <Text> [[anker]]… #tag… →YYYY-MM-DD' resp. '←YYYY-MM-DD' — Anker and Tags stand anywhere in the text, the text without Anker/Tags/markers is the display; '→date' marks the source line of an Übertrag (moved, no longer open), '←date' the target line (origin). Both markers at most once per line. Writes are LINE operations (ADR-0020): every other line stays byte-identical.

week.description: ISO week id, immutable, equals filename without .md.

goals.description: Wochenziele — at most five. A goal with an anchor or a tag counts the matching Tasks of the week as its progress; without both, the manual done flag is the whole progress.

anchor.description: Id of an Atlas entity (Kapitel, Veroeffentlichung, Projekt, Idee, Zettel). Hanging anchors are warnings, never auto-repaired.
